intent: New art directions using authentic product subject references

concepts.label: Tactile minimalism
concepts.direction: Style/medium: a sophisticated warm minimal product campaign, tactile paper sculpture and ceramic-like folded relief, softly lit photographic realism rather than flat CSS. Scene: warm off-white studio, subtle circular ridges pressed into paper visually echoing a turning Crown. A single upright Apple Watch nestled in this quiet composition, with the reference app display legible. Mood: intimate, calm, tactile. Palette: ivory, oat, soft terracotta accents and charcoal lettering. Typography: elegant contemporary editorial serif for the headline, restrained sans-serif brand name; strong contrast and confident negative space. No sage, dark-green gradient, cheap mockup shadow, or luxury perfume clichés.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one landscape App Store product-page header concept for Endless Crown, an Apple Watch-only haptic fidget app. Wide panoramic composition, approximately 21:9.
Primary request: completely redesign the artwork in the specified creative direction. This is a visual concept to choose an art direction, not an App Store interface screenshot. Create ONE finished image, not a collage, comparison sheet, or grid.
Input images: Image 1 is the authentic app-screen reference; preserve its simple dark infinite numbered list, centered 0 and the Clicks chip, with no invented app controls. Image 2 is the Apple Watch hardware subject reference only; do not inherit any prior campaign styling. Show a recognizable Digital Crown on the real right side. The app turns Crown scrolling into haptic feedback.
Text verbatim, and no other marketing text: small brand name "Endless Crown"; main headline "Turn the Crown." and "Feel the haptics." Spell every word correctly. Make the headline readable at thumbnail scale.
Composition: strong, single focal idea, generous breathing room, important text and product within the central composition and away from edges. Do not reproduce a dark sage gradient with a floating product beside generic system-font copy. Keep visual hierarchy expressive and art-directed.
Constraints: no prices, URLs, ratings, awards, Apple logos, medical or battery-saving claims, extra app features, watermark, fake App Store interface, CTA buttons, multi-panel layouts, or decorative clutter. Hardware and hands if present must remain physically plausible. The Watch screen must remain consistent with Image 1; final production will validate the authentic UI. Opaque background.

A single upright Apple Watch nestled in this quiet composition, with the reference app display legible. Mood: intimate, calm, tactile. Palette: ivory, oat, soft terracotta accents and charcoal lettering. Typography: elegant contemporary editorial serif for the headline, restrained sans-serif brand name; strong contrast and confident negative space. No sage, dark-green gradient, cheap mockup shadow, or luxury perfume clichés.

concepts.label: Playful color
concepts.direction: Style/medium: crisp, bold contemporary graphic advertising, like a well-art-directed independent design magazine. Scene: vivid cobalt blue field, warm butter-yellow typography, a few red-orange curved graphic strokes expressing Crown rotation. One clean, clearly recognizable Apple Watch with its real dark app display. Mood: playful, immediate, energetic, adult and polished. Typography: large bold expressive sans-serif, a confident editorial composition with intentional asymmetry and generous space. Use a small number of large graphic elements. Avoid pale minimalism, dark gradients, glowing sci-fi waves, confetti, cartoon mascots, extra gadgets, and generic 3D blobs.

concepts.label: Editorial wrist shot
concepts.direction: Style/medium: photorealistic candid editorial lifestyle photography in natural window light. Subject: close-up of an adult's wrist wearing one Apple Watch while a fingertip from the opposite hand gently turns the Digital Crown on its right side. No face, no extra devices, no extra or fused fingers. Preserve believable watch case proportions and the reference dark screen with Clicks selected. Scene: softly blurred warm neutral everyday setting; authentic skin texture and subtle sleeve fabric. Composition: the physical Crown interaction is the hero, with clean negative space for the headline. Mood: quietly satisfying, relaxed and real. Typography: modest, well-spaced refined sans-serif in a naturally empty part of the composition. Avoid over-polished stock photography, studio floating-product treatment, office productivity props, fitness metrics, or wellness/medical symbolism.

concepts.label: Abstract haptic motion
concepts.direction: Style/medium: striking sculptural 3D campaign imagery with abstract tactile motion. Scene: a realistic Apple Watch and finely detailed Digital Crown integrated with a few flowing, broad translucent ribbons that curl in a loop, an abstract visual metaphor for turning and haptic pulses. Keep the watch physically credible, the app screen consistent with the reference, and its Crown visible. Palette: warm coral, apricot, soft lavender and deep aubergine; beautiful controlled translucency and grazing light, no green. Typography: clean expressive headline placed in calm negative space. Composition: cinematic panoramic art, strong central product focal point, motion conveyed through form rather than blur. Avoid futuristic holographic UI, audio speakers, explosions, excess sparkles, neon cyberpunk, decorative rings copied from the rejected design, and fake sensor or power icons.
